vaultCheck.title: Vault integrity check
vaultCheck.checking: Checking every file in the vault…
vaultCheck.summary: Checked {files} files in {seconds} s: {count} problems, {repairable} of them can be repaired.
vaultCheck.clean: Checked {files} files in {seconds} s: no problems.
vaultCheck.kind.truncated-utf8: Cut off in the middle of a character
vaultCheck.kind.invalid-utf8: Not UTF-8 (for example Hebrew saved as Windows-1255)
vaultCheck.kind.nul-bytes: NUL bytes in a text file
vaultCheck.kind.bad-data: Data files that do not parse (JSON / YAML)
vaultCheck.kind.case-collision: Names that differ only in upper/lower case
vaultCheck.kind.normalization-collision: Names that differ only in Unicode form
vaultCheck.kind.broken-link: Links to notes that are not there
vaultCheck.kind.interrupted-write: Saves interrupted half way (the note is missing)
vaultCheck.fix.interrupted-write: finish the save (or put the old version back)
vaultCheck.why.empty-file: open the note's history to bring back a version
vaultCheck.why.data: open the file's history to bring back a version that parses
vaultCheck.why.broken-link: use Vault Doctor: Apply Suggested Link Fixes
vaultCheck.confirm: Repair {n} problems? Every file is copied to {folder} before it changes. Notes open in a tab are left alone.
vaultCheck.repaired: Repaired {n} problems. The originals are in {folder}.
vaultCheck.skipped: {n} could not be repaired (they changed since the check, or are open in a tab).
